findings.title: Overlapping map targets commit a different edge at low zoom
findings.contract: E4-1.1 UI keyboard/touch overlapping-hit-target list disambiguation; AC07
steps: Import three-area-fixture.json into exact SHA production build; Edit; select0,0; add barrier0,0→1,0.
Move ID1 via UI to70,0→71,0, then to30,0→31,0 (these move checks pass); select0,0 and Add barrier again.
Six valid directions appear. At1500×1100 rotate map and wheel900 over map, resulting mapScale0.2592402606458915.
Pointer-click the midpoint of first target labeled Add barrier0,0→1,0 (x1000.0036,y116.2486 in recorded run).
findings.expected: Ambiguous overlapping map target resolves through the six-direction list before committing; requested first edge must not silently become another edge.
findings.actual: document.elementFromPoint returns last circle0,-28|24.249,-14, and mouse click immediately commits ID2 from0,0→1,-1. No prompt/list resolution or error; nextObstacleId advances2→3.
findings.cause: All44px circles remain pointerEvents=all at low zoom, rendered in array order, each direct onClick commits its own edge. Their centers are only about6.29px apart at recorded zoom; last painted circle intercepts the first midpoint.
findings.fix_boundary: Resolve ambiguous pointer hits via existing direction list (or equivalent exact edge disambiguation) while retaining44px effective keyboard/touch targets and one atomic operation. Re-review new SHA required.
